quotes: llama-server -hf user/model pulls weights into ~/.cache/llama.cpp
outlier-vs-llama-cpp.what: WRONG PATH for macOS — on a Mac-targeted page. Line 136 says "llama-server -hf user/model pulls weights into ~/.cache/llama.cpp". That is the Linux path. llama.cpp's fs_get_cache_directory() in common/common.cpp takes the __APPLE__ branch on macOS: cache_directory = $HOME + "/Library/Caches/" then += "llama.cpp". So on the Apple Silicon Macs this whole article is about, weights land in ~/Library/Caches/llama.cpp, not ~/.cache/llama.cpp. Confirmed by reading the master-branch source (the ~/.cache/ path is guarded by #if defined(__linux__) || __FreeBSD__ || _AIX || __OpenBSD__ || __NetBSD__).
outlier-vs-llama-cpp.fix: Replace ~/.cache/llama.cpp with ~/Library/Caches/llama.cpp on line 136 (optionally noting LLAMA_CACHE overrides it, and that ~/.cache/llama.cpp is the Linux location).
